en.decryption: Remember the sequence of primary Shishunaga rulers: Shishunaga (Founder), Kalashoka (Council), and the transition to Nandas.

fact.en: Confusing the Second Buddhist Council location: It was held at Vaishali, not Pataliputra (which hosted the 3rd).
fact.hi: Confusing the Second Buddhist Council location: It was held at Vaishali, not Pataliputra (which hosted the 3rd).

fact.en: Assuming Bimbisara belonged to the Shishunaga dynasty; he was Haryanka.
fact.hi: Assuming Bimbisara belonged to the Shishunaga dynasty; he was Haryanka.

fact.en: Mistaking the shift of capital: Shishunaga moved it to Vaishali, Kalashoka moved it back to Pataliputra.
fact.hi: Mistaking the shift of capital: Shishunaga moved it to Vaishali, Kalashoka moved it back to Pataliputra.
